# 📦 Pull Request

## ✨ Description

Provide a clear and concise description of what this PR does.

---

## 🔄 Type of Change

Select all that apply:

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix
- [ ] ✨ New feature
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update
- [ ] ⚙️ Refactor / code improvement
- [ ] 🔒 Security fix

## ✅ Checklist

Before submitting, confirm the following:

- [ ] Code builds without errors
- [ ] Tests pass locally (`npm test`)
- [ ] Linting passes (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] Documentation updated (README/CONTRIBUTING if needed)
- [ ] Accessibility verified (ARIA labels, Lighthouse audit)
- [ ] No secrets or `.env` files committed

---

If applicable, add screenshots or a link to a demo.

## 📊 Related Issues

Link any related issues here (e.g., `Fixes #123`).

---

## 🛠 Technical Notes

Add any technical details, dependencies, or migration steps.

---

## 🤝 Reviewer Notes

Anything specific reviewers should focus on.
